summary: Corbus Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K regarding the entry into an employment agreement with Leonardo Viana Nicacio, MD, as Chief Medical Officer, effective August 3, 2026. The agreement specifies an annual base salary of $545,000, an annual bonus target of up to 40% of base salary, and equity awards worth $2,100,000 (75% stock options, 25% RSUs) with standard vesting schedules. Non-compete and non-solicitation provisions apply. This filing is a routine executive hiring disclosure—not a special situation—so no deal terms are applicable.
